captions.text: A hooded figure moves through a warm amber

motion.reason: A single window flickers awake over the dark city
The street lamp hums on and throws its amber pool
Amber light pools on the wet street beneath the lamp
The hooded figure moves through the amber-lit city
Left leg steps through the shadowed street
Right leg steps through the shadowed street
Left arm swings low in the shadows
Right arm gestures, walks and halts
A final amber pool holds the halted figure
